title: Agent Trestle task manifest
description: A versioned task graph. Each task names one explicit project/workstream/role route, supplies exactly one prompt source, and may declare dependencies and stop conditions. Policy lives here rather than in .trestle/config.json so that project configuration stays small and closed.

id.description: Optional run identifier. Scopes audit segments and state for this run. Generated when omitted.

prompt.description: Literal prompt text. Mutually exclusive with promptFile.

promptFile.description: Path to a prompt file, resolved relative to the manifest and contained within the project root. Mutually exclusive with prompt.

skills.description: Skills requested for this task, merged with those declared by the agent and configured on the role.

dependsOn.description: Task IDs that must complete before this task becomes ready. Must reference tasks in this manifest and must not form a cycle.

stop.description: Explicit stop conditions for this task. Bounded execution is a project invariant, so a stop object must declare at least one bound.

maxRounds.description: Maximum execution rounds before the task stops with reason max-rounds.

maxDurationMs.description: Wall-clock bound before the task stops with reason max-duration.

maxNoOpRounds.description: Consecutive rounds with an unchanged work signature before the task stops with reason no-op.
